transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I guess I'm here because... I keep making myself throw up after I eat. Sometimes I do it in the bathroom at work, or right when I get home. I just hate it, but... it's started feeling like the only way I can actually calm down.
Before you make yourself throw up, do you feel like you are eating an unusually large amount of food?

Yeah, I do. When it happens, I can go through a full bag of chips, some pastries from the corner store, whatever leftovers are in the fridge, and a bunch of sweet drinks, all in just one sitting. Honestly, I don't even really notice how much is gone until it's all empty.
Could you tell me your current height and weight?

Honestly, I'm not really sure. I haven't stepped on a scale in a long time... looking at the numbers just makes everything worse in my head. And I don't know my exact height either, just sort of average, I guess.
Even without knowing the exact numbers, has a doctor or anyone close to you expressed concern that you are noticeably or dangerously underweight?
No, nobody has ever said anything like that to me. I definitely don't look dangerously skinny or anything. So, no, no one has been worried about me being underweight.
On average, how many times a week does this happen where you eat like that and make yourself throw up?

Well, it's been going on for months now. I'd say most weeks I have at least a couple of times where I just eat way more than I meant to. And then I have to try and undo it... usually by throwing up, but sometimes I'll just fast or try to exercise it all off.
How much does your body shape or weight influence how you feel about yourself as a person?

It influences pretty much everything, honestly. Like... I can be doing really good at the shop, getting all the dry cleaning done and feeling okay about the day. But if I just catch my reflection in the front glass and my stomach or my hips look big to me... I instantly just feel like a complete failure. It's like nothing else I do even matters if my body doesn't look right.
